nom: LANEIGE Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer: Lightweight Refillable Korean Milky Toner with Ceramide & Peptide for Hydration

avis.texte: One of the only milky toners on the market that doesnt bother my overly exfoliated & sensitive skin. It's creamy, the perfect consistency & leaves your skin looking fresh & dewy. I've tried COUNTLESS milky toners, and I always.... ALWAYS just end back up coming back to this one. No matter how much tret ive used this never burns my skin and is a beautiful base for makeup or skincare. 100000000000/10

When I used this product for the first time, I didn’t think I was going to like it. It felt a bit on the thin side, and I wasn’t sure how well it was going to moisturize my skin. It has since earned its place as one of my holy grails. It’s lightweight, super hydrating, and worth every cent I paid for it. I love this product!

My skin has never looked better! I have had acne my ENTIRE life and I find that this really helped keep my skin feeling moisturized without breaking me out. I used to never use toner until I discovered this one, and I have gone through so many bottles since I can’t live without it. If you are looking for a milky toner, this is definitely the one!

avis.titre: Do not hesitate to try. Lifechanging
avis.texte: I love this product. It moisturizes and provides a skin perfecting glow to my face. I also appreciate the refillable bottle. Economical and effective - American and European products are being left in the dust!

I have tried many toners in life. I have to say this has got to be the best one ever! Better than those expensive brands. My skin feels wonderful just after the first day!!!!! It’s leave your face so smooth and with a natural glow. It doesn’t strip your face. I’m 58 and it’s works!!! Get it!!!

One of my favorite toners! It’s a thin milky consistency but makes my skin feel so soft! My skin drinks it up. I use both morning and night. Layers well under makeup. 10/10. This is a staple in my routine.
Love this balm. It changes the moisture level of my skin and has taken years of my appearance. Use after washing my face well with a good cleanser.
Love this when I am out and about. It’s cooling and makes my skin feel soft and hydrated. Not sticky.

Super Feuchtigkeit und sehr angenehm auf der Haut. Ich benutze es morgens und abends vor meiner Creme und meine Haut fühlt sich viel weicher und ruhiger an. Auch unter Make-up funktioniert es richtig gut — inzwischen kann ich mir meine Routine ohne dieses Produkt kaum noch vorstellen
onestamente ho amato un altro tonico che è davvero stupendo, della Uriage...questo invece non tiene il confronto

Ingredient list on Amazon is not the full ingredient list on the packaging. I have an acrylates allergy and it is hard to find skin care products without this cursed molecule. Thought I found a gem when I looked at the ingredients list and acrylates were not there. When the product arrive, I double checked the box and there’s extra ingredients, including acrylates, that weren’t listed online. So now I can’t even use it. :(

I take pride in maintaining healthy-looking skin. To transition to a no-makeup look, I wanted to add a touch of dewyness. At 40, I prioritize skincare over makeup. That’s when I discovered this product. However, it felt like it was burning my skin! Initially, it appeared lovely, giving me that glass-like glow. But after an hour or so, my skin turned red and developed hives. I initially thought it was an interaction with my vitamin F serum, so I used it again on its own after a few days to test my theory. Unfortunately, the burning sensation persisted. Regrettably, this product didn’t work for me.

I have a little sensitive skin but honestly haven’t ever had issues with toners and have tried a bunch of different ones. This one feels like it doesn’t absorb at all and makes your skin feel sticky. For me personally it also make my whole face turn red puffy and itchy (honestly I’m probably just reacting poorly to one of the ingredients, but I would have still left a 1* review even if I didn’t because the sticky tacky feeling is awful)

Horrible packaging redesign! Look how much of this almost brand new product I just accidentally poured down the drain, because the dispenser top was attached/stuck to the new screw top lid! Don’t get me wrong this is one of my favorite skincare products I’ve been buying it for years, but the bottle redesign is garbage.
Nice formula, however the bottle immediately broke. Amazon directs you to Laneige but they do not provide any support for products purchased through Amazon. I lost at least 0.5-1oz of product.
Maybe my luck , but received the item with just less than 1/4 of liquid
I specifically ordered this to try out the new formula. They have the new formula bottle in the picture but I got the old formula. I’m very upset

avis.titre: Left my skin feeling lightly sticky and tacky
avis.texte: Went on nice but after dried it left skin feeling slightly sticky and tacky for the day. Like a thin layer of tackiness. I didn’t enjoy this as I already have to deal with working outside and this felt like it wants to grab little bits of lint or such that touches you at all. When touching with fingers on your face after dried it would feel sticky/grabby too. I also don’t enjoy how this product container seems so nice but it’s just a huge twist off cap that you the shake the milky toner moisturizer out. It would be better if they had made it like a pump type.

1 star for packaging. Top part of bottle is stuck in the cap. Really annoying because I can’t dispense the product without a lot pouring out. I love that they have reusable packaging and was hoping to reuse this, but now probably not. 5 stars for actual product. My skin loves it. Very hydrating.
Hydrating! Great under my vitamin c. The mist is perfect. I use it mid day too! It’s like a pick me up for my face

avis.titre: UPDATED Love the product, this time it did arrive leaking
avis.texte: Love the product, this time it did arrive leaking and the product box was completely soaked and soggy UPDATED I tried to open it and the dispenser is stuck to the cap and I can’t get it off, also can’t use it without spilling it
I have been using this product for 3 months straight now. It's light weight and does what it is suppose to do.🗣 REORDERING!!!!

I was sent the older formula, without the cerapeptides added, which was disappointing. The toner itself is just fine. It’s kind of a milky thin formula, but I don’t find it absorbs fast. It stays just the teeniest bit tacky, and I really find that annoying. I guess I just had really high expectations. Oh well.
The consistency is liquid. But after applying to the skin there is a feeling of stickiness and film on the face. It is poorly absorbed. I would not recommend it.

avis.titre: New formula is not sealed anymore.
avis.texte: I’ve used 10+ bottles of Laneige Cream Skin. This new formula or packaging does not include the safety seal anymore. I hope this product is safe to use.

This serum is perfect for Florida’s climate and for my dry, sensitive skin. I use it every day - it doesn’t cause redness, feels lightweight, and is not sticky at all. I also like applying it to a sponge before foundation - the coverage turns out soft, and the skin feels well hydrated☺️🌤️

“I’ve been using this milky toner morning and night for about a week, and overall I think it’s a great product to give your skin that extra hydration it needs. One thing I really liked is how thin it is and how just a little bit goes a long way. It drastically reduces the appearance of my fine lines under my eyes because it is THAT hydrating. The best part? It doesn’t irritate my skin like other toners and is good to use if you are on tretinoin or another retinol. One downside is that it is a little pricey and a little sticky after putting it on your face, but it is not a big deal if you put a little moisturizer on top. Overall, I’d recommend this for anyone who is looking to keep their skin extra hydrated without putting a thick/heavy cream all over their face.

I have to try all of the toners and this one has excellent word of mouth hype. I consider this in a class of k-beauty milky toners with the Tirtir one, the Dr Ceuracle kombucha essence and the I’m From rice toner. All are incredibly hydrating and moisturizing for my dry, sensitive skin. This fragrance free one boosts the skin barrier with peptides, ceramides, and white leaf tea (amino acids). In the morning, I apply one layer to get the glass skin effect and then multiple layers (usually 3) at night to improve my skin barrier. Out of all the milky toners, this one may have the edge on the others because I can purchase a refill pouch and just refill the bottle(s) I have. I love less waste. The way this one falls short is that it is pricey compared to the other toners in its category. Also a lot of product comes out of the dropper when I shake the bottle so I end up using too much product.

avis.titre: Love this but I won’t recommend if you have a lot of fungal acne
avis.texte: I have ( sensitive/normal/combo skin) I really like this one. It’s very moisturizing and gives a glow but I have noticed that my fungal acne is popping up a little after using it bc it’s a little oily. I used to have a lot of fungal acne some years ago but it’s mostly gone now but it’s not really a problem for me anymore so if you have fungal acne then I would stay away!! Wouldn’t recommend if you have oily skin also

avis.titre: My sensitive skin loves this stuff
avis.texte: Sooo moisturizing! I have nothing else on my face other than a few spritz of this product. This is it dried. It does not have a scent nor does it feel sticky, oily or heavy. I have very sensitive skin and always get hesitant to try new products because they immediately make me break out, turn red and get so itchy. None of that has happened. Very happy with this product:)
Super moisturizing and easy to use . The one thing is that it’s a small bottle but you do need like a couple of drops so it’ll last depending on skin . It’s also not sticky at all.

If you have dry skin, this cream skin is amazing. I have somewhat oily skin and I still love this. It’s especially nice in the dry seasons like winter. With Korean skincare, you have “skin” moisturizer which is the liquid moisturizer that you apply first before you apply the emulsion/lotion. In the winter I use it very liberally and it keeps my face well hydrated. I’ve read that if your skin type isn’t super dry then this cream skin can make you break out from being smothered but I haven’t found that to be the case even in humid climate. I use it in the summer too and sometimes just by itself without using lotion and my face is still moisturized. Definitely would recommend if you have dry skin.

avis.titre: Cream Skin, Main Character Energy ✨ (No 10-Step Performance Required)
avis.texte: If plump, juicy, “suspiciously good, don’t ask me my secrets” type of skin is your goal, Laneige Cream Skin understood the assignment. The second this touches my face, my skin is like: OOOHH!!… we’re hydrated-hydrated!! Bouncy. Cushiony. Glossy in a healthy way. Not greasy, not slick, just that soft, supple, “expensive skin” look. My face feels like it drank a full glass of water, took a nap, and woke up emotionally stable. Now, before you ask why there’s no after photo of my face right now…. Listen. I’m currently wearing a barrier repair cream, which means my face looks like I lost a fight with a jar of white paste. That’s exactly why I’m showing the before and after on my arm instead. Same results, minus the jump scare. As an esthetician, I like to keep things simple. I do not believe in 10 step skincare routines for daily life. Unless I’m giving a facial, it’s too much to do on a daily basis Period. Skin doesn’t need to be gutted and renovated every time you wash your face. It just needs good products, solid formulations and consistency. That’s why I love that Cream Skin is a toner AND a moisturizer. Two steps knocked out in one go. Efficient. Elegant. No chaos. No trendy nonsense that’s going to wreck your skin barrier. That sounds like my kind of product. Bottom line: If you want skin that looks plump, juicy, calm, and well-behaved (unlike kids these days 😜) without overworking it, Laneige Cream Skin is that girl. Minimal effort, maximum glow.

I've never been able to find a moisturizer that wouldn't clog my pores anytime I used it, even in moderation. I have combo skin, dry everywhere beside my t-zone. This moisturizer, is an ACTUAL game changer!!! I bought one a little under 2 weeks ago on prime-day and I have been using it ever since. My skin has never looked this good, and stayed looking this good. A few days ago, I bought another one of these as a gift for my mother since she has given me nonstop compliments about my skin. Treat yourself, you will not regret it! p.s. A LITTLE GOES A LONG WAY!!! Be careful dripping it out, you can get more than you wanted, so take it easy.

avis.titre: Please Read for An honest review
avis.texte: I’ve struggled with the most stubborn dry skin , that is sensitive to almost EVERYTHING I try to apply. My skin type is Dry , Tight and Sensitive no matter how much consistency and product i’ve been recommended by my Dermatologist NOTHING WORKS. I’ve decided to give this a try and oh my gosh!!! My skin feels sooo supple and leaves it feeling comfortable. No fragrance is a PLUS for sensitivity. Use this along with the water bank cream ! You WILL see a difference. Picture of my skin (with no makeup!!!) weeks after using This toner with the Laneige Water bank along with corsx Essence. chefs kiss
It is great product but bit pricey. Finished quickly then I replaced it with tirtir which is cheaper but laneige was better quality for sure, especially with laneige cream

I originally bought the Rhode glazing milk but as someone with super sensitive and eczema prone skin, that made me break out horribly. I bought the mini milky toner of this product and honestly love it! It’s rather thin consistency but feels hydrating and gives your skin a glow. I’ve been using it for about 4 days and haven’t had any breakouts

avis.titre: NEED TO TIGHTEN THE INNER CAP TO MAKE CLICK!!
avis.texte: I LOVE THIS PRODUCT! HOWEVER Be Carful! When I unscrewed the lid, the inner dispenser lid also can come undone!! I lost a 1/4 of my bottle down the sink. I tested it again after tightening the inner dispenser and the same thing happened. Now I am transitioning to all of the Laneige products. But I’m not a wealthy woman and loosing product like that hurts. So be careful and make sure your toner is secure before using the product each time. Best of youth and beauty to all! RE- RECOMMENT. I WASNT TIGHTENING THE WHITE INNER CAP UNTIL IT CLICKED! That made it loose product when I opened it. Nothing wrong with the bottle.
My skin got super dry so I put this on and after about two days of using it my skin immediately was so soft. Even though I have the mini one it is the exact same.

avis.titre: The best toner and moisturizer you'll ever find!
avis.texte: This has changed my skin in many ways. I have combination skin, which for me is dry cheeks and an oily T zone. This has made my skin so much softer and even toned all around. I used to have dry patches on my cheeks that would peel and be painful to touch. Now my skin looks supple and hydrated. Even when I don't use it every day, my skin is still glowing and smooth! I posted a video of the size difference between the 5.7 oz and the 1.6 oz. Also I added pictures of before and after use! I'll buy Laneige every single time. Forever buying Cream Skin!

Leaves your skin light and fresh. I bought the little bottle and that’s all I need for a while, a little goes along way. I use every night before bed and wash my face in the morning. So far I like it to keep skin hydrated and isn’t harsh on skin.

First, I want to say this product smells like a hint of horchata, which is amazing cause it smells good. Next thing I want to say is that it makes my face looking moisturized all day. I use a regular face toner first to remove excess oils and dirt (after washing my face of course) and then I use this last. I am so happy with it and I do use it sparingly sometimes just because I got the smallest bottle but I will definitely keep purchasing this product.

For the last year, I've had a super gross dry patch of skin that, no matter what treatment I threw at it (from exfoliating, changing my pillow cases nightly, using a different towel JUST for my face every day, and even dermatologist prescribed topical steroids) did not improve. I bought this at the suggestion of a random person from Reddit, and this LANEIGE cream fixed the issue in about TWO WEEKS. I was so impressed I bought the large pump bottle and plan to use this as part of my skincare routine going forward forever. Definitely worth trying this product for $15, and (once it works for you), getting the larger version. 10/10, thank you random Redditor, and thank you Laneige!
This cream skin toner adds a really nice base layer to my skincare routine. Its like a milky toner—a solid staple for layering.

This toner is amazing! It feels super light but still gives my skin so much moisture. My face feels soft and calm after using it, and it doesn’t make me break out. I’ve been using it every day and totally love it. Definitely buying again!
I bought the mist attachment for this toner. It's very high quality. It gives a beautiful, diffuse spray pattern. I often prefer mists to pumps, so this is perfect for me.
Great product. More of a moisturizing Toner which I found interesting but, that being said, I suppose it has dual functions.

avis.auteur: This comforter is so comfy and thick! My
avis.texte: I started Accutane 2 months ago and have been trying to perfect my skin routine to lock in moisture. This product has saved my skin. My skin looks radiant and glowy with just this product alone.

Please make a larger size with the spray pump included! The 1 oz bottle is already $16, and the 5.75 oz bottle is $36. After paying that much, why do I still have to spend another $6 just to get the spray pump? The regular pouring opening is so inconvenient—it spills product everywhere and wastes it. A spray pump just makes so much more sense for this product. It’s honestly not worth it. I’m probably going to switch to other brands that include a spray pump instead. It’s even more frustrating that the spray pump isn’t even sold on Amazon, so if you buy the large bottle there, you can’t get the official spray pump at the same time and have to go to Sephora just for that. Seriously, why?

avis.titre: Korean skin care sheet mask from a brand you can trust
avis.texte: I'm a fan of Korean skin care products for my mature skin, and Laneige is one of the brands I trust the most. So I was thrilled to try their Cream Skin Milky Hydration sheet mask. You get five masks in a package, which puts them on par with the cost of other sheet masks from comparable brands, and makes them more cost effective than buying sheet masks one at a time from beauty supply stores or drugstores, so I definitely rate these as good value for money. The sheet mask comes soaking in product. There's a protective film but only on one side. The mask is lightweight and good sized; in fact, it was almost too big for my face! It feels luxurious when on - so much product! - and there's no discerable fragrance but I removed it after twenty minutes because while the mask hadn't dried out, my face had had enough. I massaged the remaining product into my face and it left my skin feeling hydrated but slightly tacky to the touch. I used excess product on the back of my hands and my forearms (sadly, they're aging, too!) and it did brighten my skin but also left a slightly tacky residue. My face is glowing and some wrinkles have been plumped, so I'm happy with the intital results. Those effects will fade, of course, but if you are looking for a temporary facial pick me up, this mask could do the trick. I didn't see anything alarming in the ingredient list and while the list is heavy on the usual chemicals, the mask also includes fruit and flower extracts, meadowfoam seed oil, hyaluron

I really like the formulation of this mask. The first half of the ingredient list is focused on hydration and moisturization, with glycerin, multiple hydrating glycols, caprylic/capric triglyceride, meadowfoam seed oil, panthenol, hyaluronic acid, and tremella mushroom extract - all ingredients my skin loves! This isn't just a basic sheet mask with some glycerin thrown, the formula is genuinely built around hydration and maintaining comfortable, moisturized skin. It also has some nice barrier-supporting ingredients, including ceramide NP and hydrogenated lecithin, along with a combination of Centella ingredients including madecassoside, asiaticoside, asiatic acid, and madecassic acid. There are also two peptides, acetyl tetrapeptide-11 and copper tripeptide-1, although these appear much farther down the ingredient list, so I would consider them a nice bonus rather than expecting this to function as a concentrated anti-aging peptide treatment. The formula is also fragrance-free and doesn't contain essential oils or the fragrance allergens I often see in skincare, especially masks, which I really appreciate. I like to leave it on a little longer on my face that instructed and it doesn't dry out. Once I'm done, I like layering a thin moisturizer over it to "lock everything in." This leaves my skin feeling hydrated, plump, and nourished. That's really what I want from a mask, since I want my anti-aging to come primarily from my serums.

I’ve used the LANEIGE Cream Skin Milky Toner for a while, so I picked these masks up out of curiosity, and they’re a nice complement to it. The formula has ceramides and peptides, and you can feel it’s more concentrated than the toner alone. The fit is comfortable and lightweight, and the little mesh pockets do a good job holding extra product against the skin instead of it dripping off. After use, my skin felt cooled, calm, and noticeably more hydrated, with my moisture barrier feeling a bit stronger the next day. I’ve also used one mid-day when my skin felt dry, which worked well as a quick pick-me-up before makeup. At $19 for 5 masks, it’s a reasonable price for the quality. Good option if you already like the Cream Skin line or want an easy hydration boost.

This product is truly awesome. It moisturizes visibly after usage. It’s not unpleasant feeling or ill fitting. It’s just a really good all-around design product. Each mask is individually packed with a substantial amount of product inside. They make it easy to unfold with a second layer for the mask to adhere too, so you’re not spending too much time detangling the mask. Also, it’s comfortable and stays on during the full duration of 20 minutes. Definitely really recommend this mask and find that even after the first use, I noticed a difference in my skin. Will definitely restock for days when I feel like I need to pick me up.

This is a box of 5 masks at about four dollars each. The price is steep but the masks are probably the best I have tried. When you open the package the masks are sitting in solution, really wet. You have to unfold them carefully and apply them then remove the mesh outer part that holds it together. I let it sit for 20 minutes and when I removed it there was still a lot of product on my face. I had to rinse some of it off because it was too much. I don't really know how much was absorbed into my skin but it felt really great afterward and I didn't need to apply any additional moisturizer for bed. There really wasn't a fragrance and it wasn't 'greasy' although it was a lot of product like I mentioned. I really do think these are great but a bit expensive so maybe a 'treat' once a week or twice a month. Honeslty it has been 24 hours and my skin still feels really soft so pretty awesome product.

I’ve always had great experiences with LANEIGE products, and this Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer is no exception. It has a lightweight, milky consistency that absorbs quickly while still leaving my skin feeling hydrated and soft. My skin feels moisturized without feeling greasy or sticky, and it layers well under the rest of my skincare routine. The refillable packaging is a nice bonus, and the included sheet masks are a great addition if you enjoy giving your skin an extra boost of hydration. Overall, this is another quality product from a brand I’ve come to trust. Pros: * Lightweight but deeply hydrating * Leaves skin feeling soft and smooth * Absorbs quickly without a greasy finish * Great for layering with other skincare products * Refillable bottle is a nice eco-friendly feature * Includes sheet masks for extra hydration * Trusted, high-quality brand Cons: * May be more expensive than basic toners * Those with very oily skin may find it slightly richer than a traditional toner Final Thoughts: I absolutely love this product. The quality matches what I’ve come to expect from LANEIGE, and I think it’s well worth the price for the hydration and overall performance. I would definitely recommend it and will continue purchasing it.

avis.titre: Supple, moisture mask! Great if using Trent!
avis.texte: As a busy boy mom in my 40s, my skincare routine needs to work fast and actually deliver. I use Tretinoin regularly for anti-aging and acne, but anyone on Tret knows the struggle with flaky dryness that can occur that I want to avoid. The LANEIGE Cream Skin Milky Hydration Sheet Mask 5-Pack definitely helps! It has officially become my weekly Sunday night ritual! It is packed with ceramides to help my skin barrier and keep dryness from trentinoin at bay! Each mask is saturated in the milky essence that instantly cools and moisturizes my skin. The sheet material itself holds onto the product beautifully and doesn't dry out. After leaving it on for 10 minutes my skin looks so incredibly plump and hydrated. There’s always a ton of extra milky toner left inside the pouch, so I squeeze it out and rub it all over my neck. It doesn't leave a sticky For the price, it is a great value! Often these sheet mask cost like $10 each!

My skin feels deeply moisturized, and that moisture lasts until the next day. There's absolutely no stickiness or oiliness. It has no scent. I experienced no skin irritation or allergies. The face mask is on a mesh sheet. I placed it directly on my face and slowly peeled the mesh sheet off the face mask. The face mask didn't stick together, and it adhered easily to my skin. There was still lotion left in the packet, so I was able to moisturize my neck, arms, and legs as well. The quality and feel were great, and 5 masks for this price is reasonable.

I’m already a huge fan of LANEIGE, so I was excited to try these because their products have always been some of my favorites! I’ve used their skincare before and have always been impressed by how hydrated and soft my skin feels afterward. I’ve been using these masks as a little hydration boost when my skin feels dry and I love how lightweight it feels while still giving my skin that deeply moisturized feeling. I really like that it feels soothing and cooling when I apply it, and Iike the nourishing ingredients because my skin definitely benefits from extra barrier support. The formula feels luxurious without making my routine complicated. I’ll definitely keep these in my skincare rotation for when my skin needs an extra dose of hydration!

avis.titre: Hydration without the heaviness. Nice value for a set of 5…split this for gifts!
avis.texte: I really like this set of Laneige sheet masks. The milky serum is hydrating without being heavy. It’s more like an essence or very thin serum, than a toner. I was surprised by how moisturized my skin felt, considering the formula isn’t particularly rich or emollient. The sheet mask is easy to apply and doesn’t feel slimy or sticky. I used it for 30 minutes or so before bed, then layered on a night cream. There’s extra serum in the packet, so you can use that on your neck and chest. Perfect set to use if you’re planning for multiple work/teacher/thank you gifts or stocking stuffers. Each of the 5 masks is individually packaged. Very good quality, brand is recognizable, and this formula is gentle enough for most skin types. You could add a mask to a few other small skincare products to make a nice little gift.

I bought these LANEIGE sheet masks for my tween daughter to use during a sleepover with her friends, and they ended up being one of the highlights of the night. The girls had so much fun doing a little at-home spa night together, and every single one of them commented afterward about how soft, smooth, and moisturized their skin felt. It made the evening feel extra special and gave them a fun activity to do together. The masks were easy to apply, stayed in place well, and left their faces feeling refreshed without any sticky or greasy residue. I love finding products that are both fun and actually deliver on their promises, and this was definitely one of them. If you’re planning a sleepover, birthday party, or just want a little self-care treat for your tween, these are a great choice. I’ll absolutely be keeping these on hand for future girls’ nights.

avis.titre: Left my face feeling oily and sticky at the same time somehow
avis.texte: I’m usually a fan of Laneige products, I use there cream cleanser and lip mask daily, and rotate there Water cream moisturizer and hydro essence with a few other skin care products depending on my needs that day. So I was excited to give this LANEIGE Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer a try. Unfortunately I’m not a fan of this one at all, it just doesn’t work well with my type of skin I guess. It claims to be a toner and moisturizer in one. Honestly, I don’t think it did a good job of neither toning or moisturizing. It left my skin feeling sticky and gross, and that feeling doesn’t go away. It almost feels oily and sticky at the same time somehow. I have tried using less to see if that helped, and also tried applying with a cotton square instead of directly onto skin. Neither of these things made this any better unfortunately. This one is a hard pass for me.

I was incredibly impressed with this face mask! There was an abundance of product on the mask, and after removing it, I had enough left over in the package to lotion my entire body. My skin felt incredibly soft and hydrated. I left the mask on for 20 minutes and then patted in the excess product. My skin looked radiant and plump. I didn’t experience any irritation or breakouts after using either the mask or the lotion. The mask was easy to use and straightforward, and it stayed in place and fit well.

I feel like Laneige products are always a hit or miss for me. This milky toner is nicely hydrating, but has no business being $33 for 5floz because I have tried much nice hydrating toners for a more competitive price. It goes on nice an easy, like any toner you’ve used before. It’s thin and runny. I apply by shaking the product into my hand, rubbing my palms together, then patting into the skin. It has no noticeable scent. In fact, its only flaw is its tackiness. This toner feels sticky as soon as it starts drying, and then for hours after. While I’m a face of slight tackiness, especially in a hydrating serum to prime my face for make up, I hated the way this felt on my skin and it made me feel like I couldn’t layer anything on top because this wouldn’t absorb appropriately. It left my face with a nice hydrated glow after every application (photos of my face demonstrate hydrated glow of skin), but I just can’t stand that stickiness.

This milky toner leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and deeply hydrated without being heavy or greasy. It absorbs quickly and adds the perfect layer of moisture, especially when my skin feels dry or tight. I love that it combines the refreshing feel of a toner with the nourishing benefits of a moisturizer. The refillable packaging is also a thoughtful touch. A wonderful addition to any skincare routine!

This toner is so lightweight but incredibly hydrating. It leaves my skin soft, calm, and healthy without feeling sticky. I love that it doubles as a moisturizer, making my skincare routine quick and simple. Perfect for keeping my skin barrier happy! 💙

Amazing!! Definitely adding to my skin care! Before and after using this milky toner and my skin is glowing. (1 month) I also have sensitive skin. Eczema in my eyelids and oily in my nose and forehead.

avis.titre: Milky Skin Toner and Moisturizer - Leaves Skin a little sticky
avis.texte: This is a 2-in-1 skin toner and moisturizer. It has a cloudy milky color. It's liquid toner that softens the skin and hydrates. It doesn't really have any scent but leaves the skin a little sticky. I'll probably only use it at night time for that reason because though my skin likes the toner, I prefer not having to wait for it to dry out. Then I can apply other skin care products on top of it and it will absorb overnight.

avis.titre: It’s alright has a moisturizer.  A very small bottle that won’t last two weeks.
avis.texte: It’s alright has a moisturizer. There’s definitely better one out there. Not a good value for the money. The bottle won’t last two weeks.
product works well but refill came with a slow leak. Weighed only 4 oz

avis.titre: I’m on the fence about this one
avis.texte: Fit was the first issue I ran into. I have a smaller face and very small lips (not part of the filler club), and this mask is clearly cut for a larger face and lips. There was noticeably excess material, and it hung rather than sat flush. Because of the extra material, it kept shifting down over my eyes during wear, which made for a somewhat fussy 10-20 minutes, even though it was doable. The product is very glycoly in texture and thickness. Main ingredients by weight are water and glycol. Scent is very mild and not irritating. I followed the instructions exactly and took before and after photos, one before washing my face and one after showering, washing, and applying the mask. I didn’t see much change in pore appearance, though not much does affect mine visibly. I did notice shinier skin afterward, and a subtle difference in my “11s” between my brows. That could be from more relaxed facial muscles post-shower rather than the mask itself, so I’m not attributing it definitively to the product’s effectiveness, but it’s worth mentioning as a possible effect. One thing I want to mention honestly: I woke up the next morning with a bad sinus headache that lasted all day, which is unusual for me. Nothing else changed in my routine, home, or bedding that day. I can’t say for certain the mask caused it, and it may be entirely coincidental, but given the timing I think it’s worth noting as I’m not typically sensitive to anything.

I love this stuff, except it’s a pain to get out of the container. It drips through your hands and product gets wasted, and it’s weirdly annoying to try to directly put on your face. I’ve been using for almost 2 months and the top of the container randomly got stuck in the lid and I poured half the bottle onto my hand :( — I do love the product but the container sucks.
Love the product, absolutely can't stand the package design. The top gets stuck in the cap and then you can't use the product anymore or it spills everywhere.

I really like their toner moisturizer, but the packaging is a big issue. Once you open it, the inner cap gets loose, and it leaks easily. Today when I opened it to use, the cap was already loose and I ended up losing a lot of product. It’s disappointing because the product itself is good, but the packaging needs improvement.

avis.titre: Great product but came damaged and possibly old.
avis.texte: I got a small sample of this product from Sephora and it’s been one of the only brands/products that doesn’t make me break out and does wonders for my skin. However, I received it extremely damaged and I’m skeptical it may be an old product. It came in an envelope so I’m honestly not very shocked it was damaged but it had a cream-like consistency on the bottle and if you’ve used this product, you know it’s a watery-liquid kind of consistency which is what makes me believe it may be old. I also looked up the batch code and one website was saying April 2023 the other website was saying January 2024. The product leaked everywhere and was about a quarter to nearly half of the way gone. The box is dirty and beat up and the bottle is bent at the bottom and sits a little slanted. Though it came in an envelope the box looks very dirty and old and the envelope was not damaged at all. I’m very disappointed that this is my first experience purchasing the full sized product.
When I say game changer! IT’S JUST THAT. If you want baby smooth skin, this toner is everything you can imagine. In just one week I noticed a huge difference. Sis, get it!!!

Best toner I’ve used. I’ve used a bunch, mainly Korean brands, and this one’s the best. If you’re lazy some days like me and want a lightweight skin care day, you could easily do a quick 3 step toner + moisturizer + spf with this stuff. It’s really hydrating and makes skipping other steps more forgiving, unnoticeable even. I get the big bottle (you basically get 2 of the 5fl oz bottles that would normally cost $72, for $48) and ordered a pack of mist bottles. Works perfectly.

This LANEIGE Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer mask is dreamy on my skin! This toner makes my skin feel like I have completed my entire skincare routine after I use it! This is an unbelievably lightweight and moisturizing toner mask. The milky consistency feels very gentle, soothing, and hydrating on my skin. This absorbs really quick when I pat it into my skin. I love that these absorb and I have nothing left on my face! The mask does a wonderful job of pushing the serum into my skin. These leave my skin barrier feeling so hydrated and soft. I get a great glow when I use these, and long-lasting hydration. Definitely a great value for your money and ultra hydrating.

I had never tried a product quite like this one before. It’s a toner, but it’s very moisturizing at the same time. I admit I was skeptical at first, but once I tried it I was surprised to find it really did moisturize my skin! My skin felt clean, but very hydrated after using this. This is a wonderful option for dry skin or just in the cold months when a little extra hydration is needed. The scent is very light and pleasant, which added to the experience for me. I found the texture to be more milky than the average toner, but I was ok with it. Overall, this is a nice and unique find!
